description: Ask the connected AI agent (the caller of this MCP server) to propose a resolution for a single Git merge conflict hunk. Returns a fully-formed prompt with the base/ours/theirs versions and asks the agent to reply with a JSON object { "resolution": "<merged code>", "reasoning": "<short explanation>" }. This tool does NOT call any external LLM — the agent that called the tool IS the LLM. Use it when GitWand (desktop/cli) wants to delegate the resolution of a `complex` hunk to the agent driving the session, instead of calling Anthropic/OpenAI directly. Pair the agent's answer with `gitwand_apply_resolution` to write it to disk.

base.description: Content of the hunk in the merge base (common ancestor). May be empty for hunks with no shared ancestor.

context.description: Optional surrounding code (a few lines above and below the hunk) so the agent can reason about intent.

filePath.description: Path of the file containing the hunk (used by the agent to infer language and apply format-aware reasoning).

language.description: Optional language hint (e.g. "typescript", "python", "rust"). If omitted, the agent infers it from `filePath`.

ours.description: Content of the hunk from the current branch (HEAD / ours side).

theirs.description: Content of the hunk from the incoming branch (theirs side).

name: gitwand_resolve_hunk
